rarity_system.render_rule: Render the rarity text followed by a small diamond icon. Format: 'RARE ◆'. All rarities use diamond shape, only fill color varies. No brackets.

cost_indicator.render_rule: For RARE and GLORIOUS cards only, display the activation cost below the rarity diamond using a plus symbol and card icons.

stat_pips.filled_style: solid navy fill with gold outline

content.GLOSS: The dry land, ground, or soil; the material world distinct from the heavens.
content.ART_PROMPT: A pair of weathered hands holding a sphere of rich, dark soil that is crumbling slightly, with a faint glow emanating from the cracks, set against a void.
content.ABILITY_TEXT: Look at the top 2 cards of the Tower. Add 1 to your hand and put the other on the bottom.
content.OT_VERSE_LINE: Genesis 1:1 — In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
content.NT_VERSE_LINE: Matthew 5:5 — Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
TRIVIA_BULLETS: The Hebrew word 'eretz' appears over 2,500 times in the Old Testament.
Adam's name is derived from 'adamah', meaning ground or earth.
Ancient cosmology often depicted the earth as a foundation set upon pillars.

model_prompt: Generate a premium vertical trading card. Output ONLY the card; no surrounding text or watermarks. NEVER use brackets [ ]. RARITY: Print rarity text then a diamond icon (e.g. 'RARE ◆'). Diamond color: white=COMMON, green=UNCOMMON, gold=RARE, orange=GLORIOUS. All use same diamond shape. COST INDICATOR: Below rarity for RARE show '+🂠' (plus and one card), for GLORIOUS show '+🂠🂠' (plus and two cards). No cost indicator for COMMON/UNCOMMON. STAT PIPS: Use navy circles only, not diamonds. Render: header, stats, ability, OT verse, NT verse, Greek/Heb strip, trivia. Greek/Hebrew must be legible (Hebrew right-to-left). EXACT CARD TYPE: NOUN. The internal top-left badge must print that exact type label and its matching white icon. EXACT RARITY: RARE. REQUIRED COST: plus one printed card icon. Copy complete geometry from reference [1]. Render every supplied field exactly once. All Hebrew/Aramaic, Greek, transliterations, glosses, senses, testament columns, and references are immutable canonical data: copy verbatim; never translate, paraphrase, approximate, decorate, or substitute them. Never print placeholder, schema, field-name, or instruction labels such as DEFINITION TEXT, GLOSS, ART PROMPT, TYPE, or TRANSLIT.
